request.voice_description: A colossal demonic orc warlord. Extremely deep male bass voice, pitch around 90 Hz, gravelly and rough, huge chest resonance, booming like it echoes from a pit, slight growl and demonic grit on the consonants. Slow, heavy, arrogant and contemptuous delivery, every word hammered. Battle-scarred, menacing, theatrical fantasy villain. Clean studio recording, no music.
request.text: Tremble before me! In Mannoroth's name! To the slaughter! I go to destroy! This will please me. Pitiful! You fail to amuse me. I bring darkness! What trickery is this?
